title: Broker Roundup | September
summary: This month, we’re highlighting new ways Lendflow is helping business acquisition brokers and platforms create more connected financing experiences. From a dedicated SBA loan workflow to an integrated financing partnership with Bizbe, explore how technology is making it easier to connect qualified buyers with capital. Plus, take a look at the latest lending statistics shaping the market in 2026.

#### **Lender Highlight**


#### [Bizbe partners with Lendflow to launch Bizbe Capital](https://www.lendflow.com/post/bizbe-partners-with-lendflow-to-launch-bizbe-capital)


Bizbe, an AI-native business brokerage and lower middle market M&A firm, has partnered with Lendflow to launch Bizbe Capital. The integrated financing experience connects qualified buyers with financing as they move toward closing an acquisition, creating a faster, more centralized process within the Bizbe platform. Learn how Lendflow helps brokerages like Bizbe embed financing directly into the acquisition journey.
